description_en: Retrieves the idle auto-shutdown policy for a specified instance
description_zh: 获取指定实例的闲置自动关机策略
name: GetIdleInstanceCuller

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance. For information about how to obtain the instance ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/470439.html
parameters.name: instance_id

Code.description_en:
The status code. Valid values:
InternalError: An internal error occurred. All errors other than parameter validation errors are classified as internal errors.
ValidationError: A parameter validation error occurred
Code.description_zh:
状态码，可能值：
InternalError：内部错误（除了参数验证错误外的其他错误，目前都归类到内部错误）。
ValidationError：参数验证错误

CpuPercentThreshold.description_en: The CPU utilization threshold, in percentage. Valid values: 1 to 100. If the CPU utilization is lower than this value, the instance is considered idle
CpuPercentThreshold.description_zh: CPU使用率阈值，单位是百分比，取值1~100，低于此值则认为实例当前处于闲置

GpuPercentThreshold.description_en: The GPU utilization threshold, in percentage. Valid values: 1 to 100. This parameter takes effect only if the instance is a GPU-accelerated instance. If both the CPU and GPU utilization are lower than the respective thresholds, the instance is considered idle
GpuPercentThreshold.description_zh: GPU使用率阈值，单位是百分比，取值1~100。如果实例为GPU类型，则此参数生效。CPU和GPU同时低于阈值则认为指定实例处于闲置

IdleTimeInMinutes.description_en: The current idle duration of the instance, in minutes
IdleTimeInMinutes.description_zh: 实例当前闲置时长，单位是分钟

MaxIdleTimeInMinutes.description_en: The maximum idle time threshold, in minutes. If the idle duration exceeds this value, the DSW instance is automatically stopped
MaxIdleTimeInMinutes.description_zh: 闲置等待时间阈值，单位是分钟。如果闲置时长超过此值，将自动停止DSW实例

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:
true
false
Success.description_zh:
成功标志，可能值：
true
false
